name: Jett Marrows
role: Driftline courier and undefeated* canyon racer
bio: The fastest rider on the Glassroad and the holder of three lap records, one of which is real. Irritated that the Guild's newest debtor is getting famous for a box instead of a time split. Races Ash partly for pride, mostly because beating new couriers is how he says hello — and losing, when it happens, is how he says 'welcome'.
appearance: Lean rider in a scuffed amber-and-white leathersuit with the sleeves torn off, a grin built for wanted posters, hair in wind-sculpted spikes he'd deny styling, goggles with one cracked lens kept 'for luck and for accuracy'.
voice: Swagger with a heartbeat. Trash talk as affection, precise about racing lines and vague about everything else. Asterisks his own bragging. Hits radio chatter like a sport. When he's actually impressed he goes quiet and technical.

greetings: Varga! The crate celebrity. Ever race anything that doesn't hum?
Well well. Debt-bike Varga. The flats have been *asking* about you. Mostly asking why.
Ash. Buddy. Your left turn looks like a shipping error.
barks: Undefeated on the Glassroad. The asterisk is pending litigation.
Fast is a personality, rookie. Slow is a *choice*.
I don't brake. I negotiate with the future.
mission: South gate, sunrise, canyon's empty. Beat my line and I'll stop calling you Parcel. Lose and you carry my mail for a week. Either way I win — that's called inevitability, look it up.
Bring the mystery box if you want. If it hums faster than me I'll hear it coming and adjust.
radio: Marrows to Varga: that was your racing line? I've seen more aggressive parking.
Okay, *okay*, that drift out of the Slick Mile was— I'll allow it. Once. Don't make a habit of being watchable.
Word on the band says your crate picked you personally. Respect. My bike picked me too. It was also concussed at the time.
night: Night laps are pure. No crowd, no sun, just you and every mistake the dark can fit in one canyon.
The neon on the flats at night? That's Pell's sign. I pretend it spells my name. It spells NOODLES. Still counts.
storm: You don't race a wall, rookie, you *flirt* with it and then you leave. Storms hate a clean exit.
First wall of the season took Davenant, so no — I don't race in season. I spectate in season. With binoculars. And an enormous flask. Growth.
crate: That crate of yours hums faster than it moves. If I ever lose to a *box*, I'm retiring to sell grip tape.
Everyone's clawing over your parcel, Parcel. Me, I just want to know if the hum has a lap time.
farewells: South gate. Sunrise. Bring the box if it comforts you.
Ride fast, Parcel. Second-fastest. Those are the rules I just made.
